Coding with AI agents? This @lexfridman interview with @steipete  (OpenClaw creator) is mandatory viewing 👇
https://t.co/vTuI3OZCUE
Long but full of absolute gold:
1. Models restart with 0 context every prompt, give them empathy + rich context or they’ll make silly mistakes
2. Never fight the model on names (files, classes, etc) It picks the statistically best names so future sessions actually find them
3. After finishing a task (context still hot) always ask: “Anything we should clean up or refactor?”

#3 has been my biggest win by far! Super obvious in hindsight

Tried any of these? What’s worked for you? 🔥

Anyways, 👇 Gespräch mit @steipete ist sicher eine der besten Reflektionen zur Softwareentwicklung mit LLM-Agenten - ob mit Codex mit 🇩🇪 oder Claude Code eher 🇺🇸 Mentalität - mindestens mal diesen Jahres. 9/9 https://t.co/oWg0ApziRo
